# Musk Calls Claude Opus 5.5 a 'Masterpiece', Admits Grok 4.8 Falls Short


By OpenTools Team


·


November 12, 2026


Elon Musk called Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 a 'masterpiece' and conceded Grok 4.8 won't match it, while xAI rebuilds its inference stack in C and C++. New Vercel data shows Opus 5.5 is the top model by paid spend among developers.


## Musk's Rare Concession


Elon Musk called[Anthropic](https://opentools.ai/organizations/anthropic) 's[Claude Opus 5](https://opentools.ai/llms/claude-opus-5) .5 a **"masterpiece"** and admitted his own company's next model won't beat it, in a rare public concession from a competitor. "Opus 5.5 is a masterpiece," Musk wrote on X, adding that Grok 4.8 would be **"not as good"** , according to[Decrypt](https://decrypt.co/382956/elon-musk-calls-claude-opus-5-5-masterpiece-grok-wont-match) .


He hedged on the longer term, predicting that Grok 5 "should exceed Opus 5.5" within **"two or three months"** — a target with no firm date attached. Anthropic released Opus 5.5 on September 22, and the company has not publicly responded to Musk's comments.


## xAI Is Rebuilding Its Whole Stack


The admission comes with a revealing technical detail:[xAI](https://opentools.ai/organizations/xai) 's team **abandoned JAX and[SGLang](https://opentools.ai/tools/sglang)** and rewrote its inference and reinforcement-learning system in **C and C++** . Musk described the language choice as "C with a little C++," crediting[Starlink engineers](https://tech.yahoo.com/ai/claude/articles/elon-musk-calls-claude-opus-194602034.html) for work on the training stack, including custom headers and precise time calculations for leap seconds.


Grok 4.8's pretraining is finished but it's still in reinforcement learning. Musk called the current state **"not yet incredible"** but said the foundations are "built right." A soft rollout to X Bot users was expected later this week,[Decrypt](https://decrypt.co/382956/elon-musk-calls-claude-opus-5-5-masterpiece-grok-wont-match) reported, and no benchmark scores have been published for Grok 4.8.


## The Benchmark Gap


The numbers back up Musk's humility. On **Terminal-Bench 4.0** , which measures command-line agent tasks, **[Claude Opus 5](https://opentools.ai/llms/claude-opus-5) .5 scored 66.4%** ([Anthropic](https://opentools.ai/organizations/anthropic) 's self-reported figure) — well ahead of OpenAI's[GPT-6 Astra](https://opentools.ai/llms/gpt-6-astra) at **57.9%** — while Grok trails far behind with no published scores, according to[Decrypt's reporting](https://tech.yahoo.com/ai/claude/articles/elon-musk-calls-claude-opus-194602034.html) .


Opus 5.5 also runs **40% cheaper** than the previous Opus while matching the higher-end Fable 5.1 on most tasks. For builders deciding where to spend their API budget, that combination — stronger agent performance at a lower price — is exactly the kind of shift that moves workloads.


## Builders Are Already Voting With Their Wallets


The real signal isn't Musk's post — it's the spend data. **[Claude Opus 5](https://opentools.ai/llms/claude-opus-5) .5 was the top model by paid spend in its first full month** , capturing roughly **14% of model spend** in October, according to the[Vercel](https://opentools.ai/organizations/vercel) AI Gateway Production Index cited by[Yahoo Tech](https://tech.yahoo.com/ai/claude/articles/elon-musk-calls-claude-opus-194602034.html) .[Anthropic](https://opentools.ai/organizations/anthropic) 's models dominate paid usage: Sonnet 5.5 led at 26% of teams, followed by Haiku 5.5 at 22%, Haiku 4.5 at 20%, and Opus 5.5 at 18%.


Vercel also found that **AI models now have a half-life of about six weeks** — teams adopt a new model and switch to the next release within roughly a month. That churn is why xAI's multi-month delay on Grok 4.8 stings: by the time it ships, the builder community may have already moved on.


## What This Signals for the Model Race


Musk publicly ranking a rival's model above his own is more than a compliment — it's an admission that xAI has fallen behind on the agentic coding front that now drives enterprise adoption.[Anthropic](https://opentools.ai/organizations/anthropic) 's $17 billion in Q3 revenue, against a **$567 million operating loss** , shows the company has found a path to efficiency that[OpenAI](https://opentools.ai/organizations/openai) 's $10.9 billion loss can't match. xAI's full-stack rewrite suggests Musk is betting that raw systems engineering — not just more training compute — is the way back.


The[Vercel](https://opentools.ai/organizations/vercel) data cuts against the narrative that this is a two-horse race between OpenAI and Anthropic. Grok isn't showing up in the top paid-model lists, which means for most builders the practical choice right now is Claude versus GPT — with Opus 5.5 currently winning on the agentic tasks that matter most.


## What to Watch


- **Grok 4.8 rollout** Soft release to X Bot users expected this week — first real benchmark scores will show how close xAI actually got


- **Grok 5 timeline** Musk predicts Grok 5 "should exceed Opus 5.5" in two to three months, per[Decrypt](https://decrypt.co/382956/elon-musk-calls-claude-opus-5-5-masterpiece-grok-wont-match) , but no firm date is set


- **Claude Opus 5.5 adoption** Already the top paid model by spend per Vercel — watch whether the 14% share keeps climbing


- **Anthropic IPO** Anthropic lists on Nasdaq November 19 as ANT, with Opus 5.5 momentum as a key selling point
